product_overview: Aling Chona Cakes and Cupcakes is a Laravel-based public ordering and internal business management system for a custom bakery. It lets buyers submit multi-item custom cake and cupcake orders without accounts, while staff manage orders, pricing, payments, inventory, expenses, reports, schedules, and staff users.
core_goals: Allow public customers to submit custom bakery orders without logging in
Let staff review orders, adjust provisional prices, and manage order fulfillment
Record required down payments and final payments for confirmed orders
Maintain product, inventory, expense, customer, and schedule records
Provide financial and operational reporting for the business
Restrict user account administration to the Owner role

features.name: Public Order Submission
features.description: Lets buyers browse active products, build a multi-item custom order, and submit it as a pending order without payment or login.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View active products -> Select one or more products -> Enter quantities -> Provide customer name and phone number -> Add optional email -> Enter per-product customization and special instructions -> Upload a reference image -> Select pickup date and time -> Review the order -> Submit the order -> See the confirmation page at /order/success

Navigate to / -> Select products and add them to the order -> Fill in the customer details -> Choose pickup date and time -> Review the order summary -> Submit the order -> See the order marked as pending on the success page

features.name: Staff Authentication
features.description: Lets internal staff sign in and end their session to access the admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter staff email address -> Enter staff password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Sign in with valid staff credentials -> Open the navigation menu -> End the current session -> Return to the login page

features.name: Admin Dashboard Overview
features.description: Shows staff high-level business metrics and quick access to key operational areas.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View today and monthly sales totals -> View pending order counts and alerts -> Open a quick link to orders, inventory, or reports

features.name: Order Review and Price Adjustment
features.description: Lets staff inspect pending orders, review customization details, revise provisional item prices, and confirm orders.
user_flows: Navigate to /orders -> Open a pending order -> Review order details and reference images -> Adjust the provisional price for an order item -> Save the updated price -> Confirm the order
Navigate to /orders -> Search or filter for a pending order -> Open the order details -> Review customization and pricing -> Confirm the order status

features.name: Down Payment and Final Payment Processing
features.description: Lets staff record the required 50% down payment and later collect the remaining balance before completion.
user_flows: Navigate to /orders -> Open a confirmed order -> Enter the exact 50% down payment amount -> Select Cash or GCash -> Provide a GCash reference number when needed -> Submit the payment -> See the order move forward in the fulfillment process
Navigate to /orders -> Open an order that is ready for pickup -> Enter the remaining balance amount -> Select the payment method -> Submit the final payment -> See the order marked completed

features.name: Product Catalog Management
features.description: Lets staff create products, update product details, and control whether products are visible to public buyers.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Create a new product with name, price, description, and category -> Save the product -> See it added to the catalog
Navigate to /products -> Open an existing product for editing -> Update its details -> Save the changes -> See the catalog refreshed
Navigate to /products -> Toggle a product active or inactive -> See the product visibility status change

features.name: Supplies and Inventory Management
features.description: Lets staff track supplies, adjust stock levels, and monitor reorder thresholds.
user_flows: Navigate to /supplies -> Add a new supply item with unit and reorder threshold -> Save the item -> See it listed in inventory
Navigate to /supplies -> Open a supply item -> Record a stock-in transaction with quantity and cost -> Save the transaction -> See the quantity increase
Navigate to /supplies -> Open a supply item -> Record a stock-out transaction with a reason -> Save the transaction -> See the quantity decrease
Navigate to /supplies -> View the inventory list -> Observe low-stock warning indicators

features.name: Expense Tracking
features.description: Lets staff record and review operating expenses such as ingredients, packaging, equipment, and miscellaneous costs.
user_flows: Navigate to /expenses -> Enter the expense description, category, amount, and date -> Add notes or receipt details -> Submit the expense -> See it added to the expense register

features.name: Financial and Operational Reports
features.description: Lets staff review sales, expenses, and net income across selectable time ranges.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Choose a date range -> View gross revenue, recorded expenses, and net profit -> Review top-selling products and fulfillment statistics
Navigate to /reports -> Switch between daily, weekly, monthly, or custom filters -> Compare totals across the selected period

features.name: Pickup Schedule Calendar
features.description: Lets staff view upcoming pickups and deliveries by date and follow through to order details.
user_flows: Navigate to /pickup-schedule -> View upcoming pickups organized by date -> Filter the schedule by order status -> Open an order from the schedule -> See the order details

features.name: Customer Management
features.description: Lets staff create, edit, search, and review customer records and order history.
user_flows: Navigate to /customers -> Search for an existing customer -> Open the customer profile -> Review their order history
Navigate to /customers/create -> Enter customer details -> Save the new customer -> See the customer added to the list
Navigate to /customers -> Open a customer profile -> Edit the customer information -> Save the changes -> See the updated record

features.name: User Management (Owner Only)
features.description: Lets the Owner manage staff accounts, roles, and account status.
user_flows: Navigate to /users -> View the staff account list -> Open the create user form -> Enter name, email, role, and password -> Save the new staff account -> See it listed
Navigate to /users -> Open an existing staff account for editing -> Update profile details or role -> Save the changes -> See the updated account
Navigate to /users -> Attempt to access the page as an Assistant -> See access denied
